record.provider: Shuttleworth Foundation Fellowship - individual, no organisation, $275k project funding

free_tier.stated: Fellowship covers the Fellow's time for a year plus project funding reported at $275,000 per fellow per year, with the foundation matching the fellow's own contribution. Amount is set individually from the fellow's outside salary equivalent.

record.chaining: No organisation required and no geography restriction: 'Fellowship is not limited to any specific geographic location. However, applicants must be fluent in English'. Openness is the hard requirement - the work must be open source / open data / open access.

limits.value: Application needs a 5-minute video and a CV

record.limits_note: Highly competitive and theme-bound (technology, knowledge, learning for social change); requires full-time commitment and releasing all outputs openly; the fellow must put in their own money ('skin in the game'), which conflicts with a no-budget applicant. Application needs a 5-minute video and a CV.
record.reliability_note: One-year grants, renewable in practice for multi-year fellows, but per-fellow and discretionary. Not a storage programme - a way to fund one.

evidence.proved: 'The fellowship is not limited to any specific geographic location. However, applicants must be fluent in English.'
'We make sure the Fellow invests, both personal resources as well as money into their projects'

record.notes: Fellowship covers the Fellow's time for a year plus project funding reported at $275,000 per fellow per year, with the foundation matching the fellow's own contribution. Amount is set individually from the fellow's outside salary equivalent.
